description.value: Mucho Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain serving made-to-order burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and tacos with what the brand calls a 'Modern Mexicana' twist. This Penticton location sits along Main Street and offers online ordering and a loyalty rewards program. It's a quick, filling stop for cyclists passing through the Okanagan on a long riding day.
